periods.time: During the EDY incursion into Tokyo's underground city

name.zh: 地下都市防卫与援军抵达

periods.summary: Low-rank student knights and reserve defenders fight EDY units inside the underground city. Ayase rallies frightened students, Kaito joins despite being a non-Blazer, and the defenders are driven back to the final floor. Just as Kaito is about to die saving Ayase, Kuraudo and Moroboshi arrive, followed by Toka and the western Japan knights. Their elite combat power and lightning disable the EDY invasion and save the shelter from internal collapse.
periods.cause: EDY units breach the underground city after PSYON destroys the surface defense line, forcing Itsuki to deploy all available defenders.
periods.process: Ayase's sword cannot pierce EDY armor, but she holds the line and inspires students. Kaito cuts EDY joints with mundane sword mastery. The defenders eventually retreat to the last floor, where Ayase is injured and Kaito exposes himself to save her. Kuraudo drops in and crushes an EDY, Moroboshi pierces another through its core, and Toka's Hiraikou Raikou fries machines without harming allies. Returning knights from Kyushu and Vermillion complete the sweep.
periods.outcome: The EDY incursion is destroyed before it reaches the civilian shelter or command center. Itsuki commits reserves to the counteroffensive.
periods.significance: Shows the whole Japanese knight community converging to defend civilians and lets the broader Tokyo battle shift from near-defeat to counterattack.
